readings.title: The Normal Breast and Benign Breast Disease
readings.source: بر اساس فصل: The Normal Breast and Benign Diseases of the Breast
readings.passage: The functional unit of the female breast is the terminal duct lobular unit (TDLU), which consists of the terminal duct and its associated alveoli. The entire ductal system is lined by two cell layers: an inner layer of epithelial cells responsible for milk secretion and an outer layer of myoepithelial cells whose contractile properties propel secretions toward the nipple. This dual layering has diagnostic significance, because invasive carcinomas are characterized by the loss of myoepithelial cells, whereas benign in situ proliferations retain them. Most benign breast conditions reflect exaggerated responses of the TDLU to hormonal stimulation. Fibroadenomas, the most common benign neoplasms in young women, are composed of both stromal and epithelial components and typically present as mobile, well-circumscribed masses. Sclerosing adenosis, a proliferation of distorted acini within fibrotic stroma, may mimic carcinoma both clinically and radiologically, frequently containing microcalcifications that warrant biopsy. Fat necrosis, often following trauma or surgery, produces a firm irregular mass that can closely resemble malignancy. Similarly, chronic mastitis and inflammatory carcinoma may be indistinguishable on clinical grounds alone, underscoring the essential role of biopsy in the evaluation of any dominant breast mass. Ectopic breast tissue, most commonly in the axilla, may enlarge during pregnancy and raise unfounded concern for metastasis.
vocab: واحد ترمینال دکتال-لوبولار؛ واحد عملکردی پستان
سلول‌های میواپیتلیال؛ لایه بیرونی با خاصیت انقباضی
درجا؛ محدود به محل خود بدون تهاجم
اسکلروزانگ آدنوزیس؛ تکثیر آسینی‌های بدشکل با استروم فیبروتیک
میکروکلسیفیکاسیون‌ها؛ ریز رسوبات کلسیم در ماموگرافی
نکروز چربی؛ پس از تروما، شبیه بدخیمی

questions.q: 1. Why is the two-cell-layer structure of the ductal system diagnostically important?
options: because loss of myoepithelial cells marks invasive carcinoma while benign in situ lesions retain them
because epithelial cells are absent in benign tumors
because the layers determine the side of the tumor
questions.explanation: جمله سوم صریحاً: «invasive carcinomas are characterized by the loss of myoepithelial cells, whereas benign in situ proliferations retain them» — نکته هیستوپاتولوژیک کلیدی.
questions.tip: عبارت diagnostic significance در متن علامت است که جمله بعد، سوژه سوال است.

questions.q: 2. Which benign lesion most likely requires biopsy because of its radiologic appearance?
questions.explanation: «Sclerosing adenosis ... may mimic carcinoma both clinically and radiologically, frequently containing microcalcifications that warrant biopsy»؛ mimic carcinoma = شبیه بدخیمی → نیاز به بیوپسی.
questions.tip: دو واژه mimic و warrant را بشناسید: mimic = شبیه‌سازی بدخیمی؛ warrant = ایجاب کردن/موجب شدن (اقدام).

questions.q: 3. The word "propel" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to:
questions.explanation: سلول میواپیتلیال با انقباض ترشحات را به سمت نوک پستان «به جلو می‌راند». ریشه فیزیکی propel = پیش‌رانندگی.
questions.tip: همیشه وظیفه بیولوژیک ساختار را در توضیح واژه لحاظ کنید: myo- (عضله) + propel (راندن).

questions.q: 4. It can be inferred that a firm irregular breast mass:
options: may result from fat necrosis and still require biopsy for clarification
questions.explanation: «Fat necrosis ... produces a firm irregular mass that can closely resemble malignancy» + «underscoring the essential role of biopsy» → استنباط: بیوپسی لازم است حتی اگر علت خوش‌خیم محتمل باشد. گزینه always مطلق و غلط.
questions.tip: استنباط معکوس: هرچه «همیشه/هرگز» دارد غلط؛ هرچه با منطق احتیاط بالینی (بیوپسی/پیگیری) سازگار است درست.

questions.q: 5. Enlarging axillary breast tissue during pregnancy:
options: is a typical behavior of ectopic breast tissue and usually benign
questions.explanation: جمله آخر: «Ectopic breast tissue, most commonly in the axilla, may enlarge during pregnancy and raise unfounded concern for metastasis» — unfounded = بی‌پایه؛ یعنی نگرانی بی‌مورد است.
questions.tip: واژه unfounded/baseless در متن یعنی متن خودش نگرانی را رد می‌کند — گزینه‌های تشدیدکننده نگرانی غلط‌اند.

readings.title: Cancer Epidemiology in Iran: A National Profile
readings.source: بر اساس: GLOBOCAN Fact Sheet — Iran (Islamic Republic of), 2022
readings.passage: According to the most recent global estimates, approximately 137,000 new cancer cases and 87,000 cancer deaths occur annually in Iran. Cancer of the stomach ranks first in men, followed by prostate and lung cancer, whereas breast cancer is by far the most common malignancy in women, followed by stomach and colorectal cancers. The age-standardized incidence rate in men (about 168 per 100,000) exceeds that in women (about 129 per 100,000), and the cumulative risk of developing cancer before age 75 approaches 18 percent in men. Several features distinguish the Iranian cancer profile from Western patterns. First, the relatively young age structure of the population means that a substantial proportion of patients are diagnosed during their productive years, amplifying the societal burden of disease. Second, infection-related malignancies such as gastric cancer—linked to Helicobacter pylori prevalence—remain prominent, reflecting the epidemiologic transition in which infections and lifestyle-related cancers coexist. Third, hereditary cancer research has gained momentum: population studies of breast cancer have documented a notable frequency of BRCA1 and BRCA2 mutations among high-risk families, and national programs for thalassemia prevention have demonstrated that community-based genetic screening can substantially reduce the birth incidence of a severe hereditary disease. Public health planners therefore confront a dual challenge: expanding early detection infrastructure for common cancers while integrating genetic counseling services into the primary health care system that Iran has long been recognized for.
vocab: نرخ استانداردشده سنی؛ برای مقایسه بین جمعیت‌ها
ریسک تجمعی؛ خطر تجمع تا سن مشخص
بروز؛ موارد جدید در واحد زمان
گذار اپیدمیولوژیک؛ هم‌زمانی بیماری‌های عفونی و مزمن
شیوع تولد؛ فراوانی تولد نوزادان مبتلا
مراقبت‌های اولیه سلامت؛ نقطه قوت نظام سلامت ایران

questions.q: 1. What is the most common cancer in Iranian women according to the passage?
questions.explanation: «breast cancer is by far the most common malignancy in women» — by far = با اختلاف زیاد. stomach و colorectal رتبه‌های بعدی‌اند.
questions.tip: در جداول توصیفی، قیدهای رتبه‌بندی (first, followed by, by far) را زیر خط بکشید؛ سوال رتبه‌بندی بسیار رایج است.

questions.q: 2. The passage attributes the prominence of gastric cancer in Iran partly to:
questions.explanation: «infection-related malignancies such as gastric cancer—linked to Helicobacter pylori prevalence—remain prominent» — dash دومیکروبی عامل را روشن می‌کند.
questions.tip: داش‌های توضیحی (—...—) در ریدینگهای آزمون معمولاً حاوی پاسخ‌اند؛ از آن‌ها نپرید.

questions.q: 3. The phrase "amplifying the societal burden" suggests that:
options: young patients impose greater indirect costs because illness strikes during productive years
cancer only affects retired people in Iran
questions.explanation: منطق متن: ساختار سنی جوان + تشخیص در سال‌های بارور → بار اجتماعی (اقتصادی/خانوادگی) بزرگ‌تر. گزینه ۲ و ۳ با متن ناسازگار؛ ۴ برعکسِ «relatively young age structure».
questions.tip: پیامدهای اجتماعی بیماری در سوالات استنباطی، معمولاً حول بار اقتصادی/کاهش نیروی کار می‌چرخد.

questions.q: 4. The thalassemia prevention program is mentioned as evidence that:
options: genetic screening cannot work at the community level
community-based genetic screening can markedly reduce the birth incidence of a hereditary disease
questions.explanation: «national programs for thalassemia prevention have demonstrated that community-based genetic screening can substantially reduce the birth incidence» — demonstrate = نشان دادن؛ مثال تاریخی موفقیت ژنتیک عمومی در ایران.
questions.tip: هرگاه متن یک برنامه ملی را به‌عنوان «demonstrated that...» بیاورد، دقیقاً همان گزاره بعد از that گزینه صحیح است.

questions.q: 5. The "dual challenge" faced by planners consists of:
options: reducing the population and banning screening
expanding early detection for common cancers and integrating genetic counseling into primary care
questions.explanation: جمله پایانی دو جزء چالش را با while به هم پیوند می‌دهد؛ گزینه صحیح باید هر دو جزء را داشته باشد.
questions.tip: در سوالاتی که «دو جزئی» هستند، گزینه‌ای که فقط یک جزء را می‌گوید (مثلاً فقط غربالگری) ناقص و غلط است.

readings.title: CRISPR Base Editing: From Bench to Approved Therapy
readings.source: بر اساس پیشرفت‌های ۲۰۲۳-۲۰۲۵: تأیید exagamglogene autotemcel و موج ویرایش پایه
readings.passage: In late 2023, regulatory authorities approved the first therapy based on CRISPR gene editing, marking a milestone in the treatment of sickle cell disease and transfusion-dependent beta thalassemia. The treatment, known as exagamglogene autotemcel, does not repair the causative mutation directly. Instead, it edits hematopoietic stem cells collected from the patient so that a precisely targeted breakpoint is created in an enhancer of the BCL11A gene specific to erythroid cells. Disrupting this regulatory element reactivates fetal hemoglobin production, which compensates for the defective adult hemoglobin. Because the edited cells are the patient's own, immunological rejection is avoided, although recipients must still undergo conditioning chemotherapy to make room in the marrow. Parallel to nuclease-based editing, a quieter revolution has occurred with base editing, a CRISPR-derived technology that converts one DNA letter directly into another without cutting both strands of the double helix. By avoiding double-strand breaks, base editors substantially reduce the risk of unwanted rearrangements, and investigational therapies have already achieved functional correction of hemoglobinopathies in early trials. Nevertheless, important limitations persist: editing efficiency varies among stem-cell clones, long-term safety data remain limited to a few years of follow-up, off-target effects—though greatly reduced—cannot be excluded entirely, and the current cost places the therapy beyond the reach of most health systems where these diseases are most prevalent. Access, rather than science, is now widely regarded as the principal barrier between gene editing and global equity.
vocab: ویرایش ژن؛ تغییر هدفمند توالی DNA
شیمی‌درمانی آماده‌سازی؛ خالی‌کردن جای مغز استخوان
ویرایش پایه؛ تبدیل مستقیم یک نوکلئوتید بدون برش دو‌رشته
اثرات خارج از هدف؛ ویرایش ناخواسته جایگاه‌های دیگر

questions.q: 1. How does exagamglogene autotemcel exert its therapeutic effect?
options: by directly repairing the sickle mutation
by disrupting a BCL11A erythroid enhancer to reactivate fetal hemoglobin
by replacing bone marrow with donor cells
by delivering the editing enzymes intravenously without cell collection
questions.explanation: «it edits ... a breakpoint ... in an enhancer of the BCL11A gene specific to erythroid cells. Disrupting this regulatory element reactivates fetal hemoglobin» — هدف غیرمستقیم BCL11A است نه خود جهش.
questions.tip: مکانیسم‌های درمانی جدید را با «هدف» و «اثر» دو ستونه یادداشت کنید؛ سوال mechanism معمولاً یکی از این دو را جابه‌جا می‌کند.

questions.q: 2. The main advantage of base editing over nuclease editing, as stated, is:
options: avoidance of double-strand breaks and thus fewer unwanted rearrangements
no requirement for a guide RNA
questions.explanation: «By avoiding double-strand breaks, base editors substantially reduce the risk of unwanted rearrangements» — گزینه‌های دیگر در متن نیستند.
questions.tip: در تکنولوژی‌های نو، جمله‌ای که با By avoiding/By reducing شروع می‌شود معمولاً «مزیت» را می‌سازد و مستقیماً سوال می‌شود.

questions.q: 3. The word "conditioning" refers to:
questions.explanation: «must still undergo conditioning chemotherapy to make room in the marrow» — تعریف داخل جمله آمده است.
questions.tip: واژگان تخصصی درمان (conditioning) در پاساژهای ژن‌درمانی همیشه با توضیح همراه می‌آید؛ جمله را تا انتها بخوانید.

questions.q: 4. Which limitation is NOT mentioned in the passage?
options: complete absence of any therapeutic effect in all patients
questions.explanation: سه مورد اول صریحاً ذکر شده‌اند؛ «absence of any therapeutic effect» نه در متن است و نه با تأیید درمان سازگار است — گزینه مطلق و غلط.
questions.tip: سوال NOT mentioned: گزینه با ادعای مطلقِ منفی درباره اثربخشی، معمولاً جواب است چون متن درباره کارایی مثبت صحبت می‌کند.

questions.q: 5. The final sentence implies that the foremost obstacle to global impact of gene editing is:
questions.explanation: «Access, rather than science, is now widely regarded as the principal barrier» — ساختار X rather than Y به‌طور مستقیم پاسخ را می‌دهد.
questions.tip: ساختار rather than در جمله پایانی = مقایسه مستقیم دو عامل؛ یکی برجسته می‌شود و همان جواب سوال است.

readings.title: Synthetic Lethality: PARP Inhibitors and DNA Repair
readings.source: بر اساس مباحث روز: PARP inhibition in homologous recombination deficiency
readings.passage: The concept of synthetic lethality arises when simultaneous defects in two genes or pathways kill a cell, whereas a defect in either one alone is tolerable. Tumor cells lacking functional BRCA1 or BRCA2 cannot perform homologous recombination, the high-fidelity pathway that repairs double-strand DNA breaks. They survive, however, by leaning on alternative repair mechanisms, particularly the base excision and single-strand break repair pathways in which the enzyme poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase, or PARP, plays a central role. Pharmacological inhibitors of PARP exploit this dependence: by trapping PARP enzymes at sites of single-strand damage, they prevent replication forks from proceeding, converting unrepaired single-strand lesions into lethal double-strand breaks. In homologous recombination-proficient cells, such breaks would be repaired accurately and the cell would survive; in BRCA-deficient tumor cells, they accumulate catastrophically. This mechanism explains the remarkable selectivity of PARP inhibitors for tumors with germline BRCA mutations, while normal tissues are largely spared. Clinical trials established drugs of this class as effective maintenance therapy in ovarian and breast cancers associated with BRCA mutations or other forms of homologous recombination deficiency, and assays that quantify genomic scarring—cumulative signatures of past repair failure—are now used to identify additional patients who may benefit. Resistance, nonetheless, emerges through several routes, including restoration of homologous recombination by secondary BRCA mutations, replication fork protection, and drug efflux, motivating combination strategies that pair PARP inhibitors with agents targeting these escape pathways.
vocab: مرگ‌ومیری مصنوعی/ترکیبی؛ نقص هم‌زمان دو مسیر
نوترکیبی همولوگ؛ ترمیم دقیق شکست‌های دو‌رشته
زخم‌های ژنومی؛ نشانه‌های تجمعی نقص ترمیم
درمان نگهدارنده پس از پاسخ اولیه

questions.q: 1. Synthetic lethality, as defined in the passage, requires that:
options: each single defect is independently lethal
only the combination of both defects is lethal
both genes are on the same chromosome
the cell lacks all DNA repair pathways
questions.explanation: «when simultaneous defects in two genes or pathways kill a cell, whereas a defect in either one alone is tolerable» — گزینه ۱ دقیقاً برعکس تعریف است.
questions.tip: تعاریف علمی در جمله اول پاساژ اغلب سوژه سوال تعریف می‌شوند؛ کلمات whereas/while را دقت کنید.

questions.q: 2. How do PARP inhibitors kill BRCA-deficient cells specifically?
options: by trapping PARP at single-strand damage, converting lesions into lethal double-strand breaks the cell cannot repair
by directly cutting both DNA strands
by inhibiting transcription of PARP mRNA only
questions.explanation: زنجیره مکانیسمی متن: trapping PARP ← fork stalling ← conversion به DSB ← سلول HR-deficient نمی‌ترمیم ← مرگ. سلول نرمال با HR ترمیم می‌کند و زنده می‌ماند → selectivity.
questions.tip: پاساژهای فارماکولوژیک مولکولی را به‌صورت زنجیره علت-معلول یادداشت کنید؛ سوال mechanism همیشه یکی از حلقه‌ها را می‌پرسد.

questions.q: 3. The term "genomic scarring" is used to describe:
options: cumulative mutational signatures of past homologous recombination failure
questions.explanation: داش توضیحی بعد از عبارت تعریف را می‌دهد: «cumulative signatures of past repair failure» — کاربرد: شناسایی بیمارانِ کانداد PARPi حتی بدون جهش BRCA.
questions.tip: اصطلاحات بسته‌بندی‌شده (scarring, synthetic lethality, trapping) همیشه در متن تعریف می‌شوند؛ تعریف را حفظ کنید نه فقط واژه را.

questions.q: 4. Which mechanism of resistance is mentioned?
options: loss of the drug target's gene
restoration of homologous recombination through secondary mutations
questions.explanation: «Resistance ... emerges through ... restoration of homologous recombination by secondary BRCA mutations, replication fork protection, and drug efflux» — سه سازوکار ذکر شده؛ گزینه ۱ یکی از آن‌هاست.
questions.tip: سوالات مقاومت دارویی: لیست کوتاه سازوکارها در متن را شماره‌گذارید؛ طراح یکی را برمی‌دارد و سه گزینه از خارج متن می‌سازد.

questions.q: 5. The overall tone of the passage toward PARP inhibitors is best described as:
options: informative and balanced, acknowledging efficacy and resistance
questions.explanation: متن هم «remarkable selectivity» و اثربخشی را می‌گوید و هم «Resistance, nonetheless, emerges» را — لحن متعادل علمی. گزینه‌های یک‌سویه غلط‌اند.
questions.tip: لحن پاساژهای علمی استاندارد تقریباً همیشه «balanced/informative» است؛ در آزمون، گزینه balanced معمولاً صحیح است مگر متن آشکارا تبلیغی باشد.
